mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market that strengthens consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.3% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS increases >0.5% in the prior month during late-cycle expansion, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO rises >0.5% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST falls below 1200.0, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in retail sales (RSAFS) signal a virtuous cycle of strong labor market and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE falls >0.1% and RSAFS rises >0.5% in the prior month, over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO falls below 95.0, over any 3-year rolling window.
